points.text: The tracker records that DexNom, Doomsday, and darkworldhm joined the board, each claiming the stage "Runnable".
The tracker records that keylime joined the board, claiming the stage "Main menu".
The linked article reports that Take-Two's first GTA VI port takedown disables Leonida and 3,007 forks via a DMCA notice on GitHub.
The linked article reports that GTA VI's shaders start loading on omonkey's build, streamed live on Rumble, with a player walking slowly around the opening prison scene at about 5 frames per second.

sentences.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two filed a DMCA notice against Leonida, disabling 3,007 forks.
The linked article says the Discord server disappeared after the GitHub repository was deleted.
Hardware Busters reports that Project Leonida, a GTA 6 PC recompilation effort, has gone dark as fake builds spread malware.
MakeUseOf reports that fake GTA 6 PC installers are stealing accounts for a port that does not exist.
TweakTown reports that Rockstar Games' website was seized by authorities after players scanned an in-game GTA 6 QR code.
The linked article says several private PC builds of GTA VI can now play through Lucia's prologue and into Jason's first mission, Gone Fishing.
The same article says most builds still render the world badly and vehicles rarely work.
